references.text: The Lord commanded us to keep all these statutes and to fear the Lord our God, so that it may go well with us always
God expresses the desire that the people should fear him and keep his commands, so that it may go well with them
Moses conveys God's commands and statutes which the people must keep in order to live long and so that it may go well with them
An exhortation to keep God's laws and commands so that it may go well with them and they may live long in the land
A warning against forgetting the Lord by not keeping his commands, statutes, and laws
The one who keeps the Lord's laws and statutes shall live by them
The prophet Ezekiel speaks about following the Lord's statutes and commands in order to live
The Lord's commandments are right and bring joy to the heart
Paul confirms that the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good
John writes that love for God is shown by keeping his commands, and his commands are not burdensome
